title: What is the anti-nucleus antibody concentration of the patient whose total
question:
What is the anti-nucleus antibody concentration of the patient whose total bilirubin is the highest in the normal range?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: anti-nucleus antibody concentration refers to ANA; total bilirubin is the highest in the normal range refers to MAX(`T-BIL` < 2.0);

prediction.sql:
SELECT e.XCL_005
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.XCL_014 = e.XCL_001
WHERE l.XCL_025 < 2.0
ORDER BY l.XCL_025 DESC
LIMIT 1;
